title: Caliph al-Mamun's raiders find the Great Pyramid empty

tellings.quote: um Arab raiders under Calif Mamun broke in to the Great Pyramid and they found it empty.

plain: Arab raiders led by Caliph al-Mamun, a Muslim ruler, broke into the Great Pyramid of Giza in Egypt and found it empty inside. The writer Graham Hancock tells this without naming a source or a date. It matters because an empty pyramid raises the question of whether it was ever a tomb at all.
